behavior_constraints: In half_open state, allow up to half_open_max_probes concurrent probe connections instead of one
When half_open probe batch limit is reached, reject further connections until the batch completes
After all probes in a batch complete, if more than half succeeded, close the circuit; otherwise reopen and restart the open timeout
half_open_max_probes global config field defaults to 3 and is reloadable via SIGHUP
Per-service mirror_endpoint (string address:port, empty disables) and mirror_sample_pct (0-100) config fields are reloadable via SIGHUP
cache-layer service config must set mirror_endpoint=127.0.0.1:8073 and mirror_sample_pct=100
When a connection is sampled for mirroring per mirror_sample_pct, dial the mirror endpoint after the primary connects and forward client-sent data to both
Mirror responses are discarded; only the primary response reaches the client
If the mirror connection fails to establish or drops, the primary connection is unaffected
A per-service mirrored_connections stat counts mirrored connections since startup

round 5 (acceptLoop/forward/copyConn/handleConn/dispatch) — mirror dialing and forwarding piggybacks on forward/copyConn and the new IPC command extends dispatch

entities.summary: This round replaces single-probe half_open circuit breaker logic with a configurable batch of concurrent probes (half_open_max_probes) and adds per-service traffic mirroring (mirror_endpoint/mirror_sample_pct) with sampling, dual-dial forwarding, a mirrored_connections stat, get_mirror_status IPC, and meshctl mirror CLI subcommand.

instruction_head:
Update circuit breaker probing behavior and add connection mirroring support.

**Circuit breaker half_open probes**

The half_open state currently allows exactly one probe connection at a time. Change it to allow a configurable batch of concurrent probes.

Add a global config field `half_open_max_probes` (integer, default 3). In half_open state, accept up to that many concurrent connections as probes. Once the batch limit is reached, reject further connections until the batch finishes. When all
